name: timerMs
meaning: dormant countdown (g_dtMs), or the vertical-mode anim timer

name: arcIndex
meaning: current arc sample = elapsed g_gameTimeMs / 25

name: lavaFxActive
meaning: lavaBody animating and drawn; enables the 60-unit burn test

name: headVisible
meaning: draw the volcano's own body (the bomb)

name: landed
meaning: bomb has splashed; stops the head collision sweep

name: vertical
meaning: PROPERTY_VOLCANO_VERTICAL (0 in every shipped placement)

name: uTurn
meaning: PROPERTY_VOLCANO_UTURN (0 in every shipped placement)

name: reverseNext
meaning: with UTURN: the next eruption runs backward (state 2) after 500 ms

name: splashDone
meaning: splash played for this eruption

name: trailEndIndex
meaning: last arc index the trailing blobs may use; truncated to the impact index

name: startTimeMs
meaning: g_gameTimeMs when the eruption started

name: blobActive
meaning: per trailing blob: visible this frame

name: state
meaning: VolcanoState

name: homePos
meaning: crater position (pos at Init)

name: blobVel
meaning: blobDelta*50; |y| sets the blob stretch in Render

name: arcPoints
meaning: TRAJ1 arc pre-sampled at Init (38 used)

name: blobDelta
meaning: per-blob step between consecutive arc samples; orients the blob

name: loopIndex
meaning: member used as a loop counter by Init, Update and Render

name: lastArcIndex
meaning: number of sampled points - 2

name: arc
meaning: quadratic through the 3 TRAJ1 points, 3-D mode (flags 6); used only at Init

name: hitBox
meaning: flags 1; crater box +-15 (a Rock overlapping it plugs the volcano), or the lava column in vertical mode

name: hitPending
meaning: head sweep hit a non-Wolf; splash on the next frame

name: lavaBody
meaning: embedded ScnBody from WAR_IDO_ALAVE02 (fountain anim 1 / splash anim 2 / column anim 0); pos at +0x444, rot at +0x44c, anim flags at +0x49a

name: blobs
meaning: 5 embedded ScnBody from WAR_IDO_ALAVE03, stride 0x64, trailing the bomb 2 samples apart

name: lavaRecord
meaning: record synthesised for ALAVE02

name: blobRecord
meaning: record synthesised for ALAVE03

name: lavaModelRes
meaning: Scn_BuildRecordFromExport result for ALAVE02; Render draws lavaBody only when it is set

name: blobModelRes
meaning: Scn_BuildRecordFromExport result for ALAVE03 (0 in vertical mode)
